sentences.text: The withdrawn RBI circular on the Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Loans & Advances does not show any replacement document in the evidence provided.
For a Tier 3 UCB, the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions still require a KFS to be provided to prospective borrowers in the standardised format in Annex XIII.
Those in-force UCB directions also require the KFS to include the APR computation sheet, the amortisation schedule, and the summary box as part of the loan agreement.
If you want the exact replacement under a different RBI instrument, the evidence searched here does not identify one.

missing.searched: Looked for an in-force RBI or UCB rule that expressly replaces the withdrawn KFS circular; the provided evidence does not identify any such replacement.
